# libjpeg-turbo, vendored

Upstream **3.2.0**, released 2026-06-30, from
<https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo/releases/tag/3.2.0>.

    libjpeg-turbo-3.2.0.tar.gz
    sha256 6f30092cef9fb839779646608f4ee14ae3cbac989c47fa05e841b0841f09878e

Licensing is unchanged and is in [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md): a three-clause BSD
licence over the IJG licence, both permissive, both requiring the notices be
kept. Nothing here has been modified, only removed.

## Why it is here at all

The NDK ships no JPEG encoder. `Bitmap.compress` reaches Skia's copy of this
same library, but through an interface that offers no control over it — one
call, one thread, no restart interval — and encoding a 12.5 MP capture there
costs about 240 ms, the largest single item in a shot. Having the library
directly is what allows the image to be cut into strips and encoded at once.

## What was removed

Nothing was edited. These were deleted because they cannot contribute to an
Android arm64 build, and carrying them would mean carrying several megabytes of
test images and four other architectures' assembly:

- `doc/`, `testimages/`, `test/`, `java/`, `jna/`, `fuzz/`, `win/`, `release/`,
  `cmakescripts/`, `sharedlib/`, `src/md5/`, `src/spng/`
- every SIMD target but ARM64: `simd/i386`, `simd/x86_64`, `simd/powerpc`,
  `simd/mips`, `simd/mips64`, `simd/loongson`, `simd/riscv64`, `simd/nasm`,
  `simd/arm/aarch32`
- the upstream `CMakeLists.txt` files, which are not used — see below

## How it is built

Upstream's build system deliberately refuses `add_subdirectory()` and directs
downstream projects to adapt it, so its `CMakeLists.txt` files were removed
rather than left in place to mislead. The sources are listed in
[../../CMakeLists.txt](../../CMakeLists.txt) instead.

`jconfig.h`, `jconfigint.h`, `jversion.h` and `simd/arm/neon-compat.h` are
generated by upstream's CMake rather than shipped. They are in `generated/`,
produced by configuring 3.2.0 with the NDK toolchain for `arm64-v8a`,
`android-33`, `WITH_SIMD=1`:

    cmake -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=$NDK/build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake \
          -DANDROID_ABI=arm64-v8a -DANDROID_PLATFORM=android-33 \
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DENABLE_SHARED=0 -DENABLE_STATIC=1 \
          -DWITH_TURBOJPEG=0 -DWITH_SIMD=1 -DREQUIRE_SIMD=1 <srcdir>

## Updating it

Re-run the above against the new release, replace `generated/`, refresh the
source list in the parent `CMakeLists.txt` from upstream's `JPEG_SOURCES`, and
delete the same directories. `JpegEncodeParityTest` is what says whether the
result still produces the same picture.
